bayts.text: I have turned my face to Allah, and He makes me abide, and with what surpassed my expectation He lets me meet.
My word, my creed and my deed have turned to the Most High, and this year He tamed for me a deceiver who almost ruined me.
He turned toward me today, from His enemies, the base, a spoil that opened for me the door of a precious (treasure).
His reward — exalted be He — frees from the reward of the emirs, and from seeking a provision guaranteed by Him.
An unveiling that came to me from Him, an exile among the enemies, removed every ambiguity and conjecture.
The All-Embracing, the Enricher, has given me, without despoiling, opening and outpouring, with glad tidings and safety.
I praise the Truth, and He is Allah — exalted and glorified be He —, and with charisms in the two Abodes He protects me.
He bestowed on me unveiling and enabling grace, possessed of succour, and for me He appoints, truly, every appointing.
He laid down the faults together with the burdens on my part, as He spared me suffering the devils.
The Mighty, Who never ceases to be All-Powerful, strengthened my weakness, and all the sultans made peace with me.
Their hearts turned toward what I choose, by His being for me in the manifest and the hidden.
I have trusted in the One, the Subduer, turning away from the prohibitions and from the deeds of a madman.
I increased repentance toward a Lord Who returned my wares to me after the purchase, with my opening of the unseen, and He enlightens me.
He is the All-Aware (Al-Khabīr) Who informs me of the unseen, and with outpourings and succours comes to me.
My heart, my body and all of me, Allah guards them from corruptions in the two Abodes, from my (first) time.
To Him I have already repented of my breaking pacts, together, and of all that He did not approve for me, from my (first) time.
To Him be my repentance and my sale, hoping forever for His forgiveness; and He heals me with the Qurʾān.
Guidance has appeared to me, and I seek no substitute for it; and the radiant Sunna of the Chosen suffices me.
Through it I repel falsehood from me and drive it away; and if I thirst, the outpouring of Allah is for me, and (praise) is His.
My exile became good through Allah's being for me; and to Him be my praise and my gratitude; and through the Effacer He makes me ascend.
To Him is my taking refuge through him (the Prophet), a slave, with his Sunna, and I seek refuge in Him from every accursed one.
Make my ink and my pens, with "Be", O my King, the glad tidings of the Followed and the glad tidings of Your wide-eyed houris.
I have cast away what was with me: so drive to me a substitute forever, and grant me the best establishment.
You saved me from the harm of the enemies, an exile: so grant me to be possessed of return and repose.
You took harm away from me through the Chosen, out of generosity: grant me perseverance in what pleases You, with betterment.
To You be praise, good pleasure from me and laudation, O You Whose hospitality makes me forget the harm of the enemies.
You showed me the Truth on Thursday, when I was a stranger like the one of the valley (Moses) and the one of the fish (Jonah).
Save me and unveil for me sciences that belittle the steady rains, and bestow on me a mighty secret from You, hidden.
You made my soul good: so increase its being made good forever, and make my life an unfailing reward.
Be for me with bounty and honour without despoiling and without reckoning, and drive to me the best stored (treasure).
Hold back harm forever toward others; guard my side, in this world and the Next, a servant not saddened.
Make my reckoning what I met and what passed among the Christians, tomorrow, on the day of the scales.
You saved me today from them after their onslaught: so increase my salvation and bestow the treasuries on me.
Increase me in sciences, increase my striving and increase my refinement, O You Who save me from disgrace and the two fires.
Grant me, by Your might, my mastering all the base, and spare me the people of Zaqqūm and Sijjīn.
You spared me them and tamed them all for me, docile, after I had been like a captive and a prisoner.
Protect me from all that You did not approve for me, O my Eternal Refuge, O You Who spared me a wicked one who almost ruined me.
Write a blessing with Tasnīm (the spring of Paradise) for our master Muḥammad, him through whom You guide me to the Truth.
